product: Lapisan Console (Lapisan by AntaraX) and AXLE Central (planned)

surfaces.responsive: One breakpoint for the shell, max-width 860px (globals.css:156-162): grid becomes one column, sidebar goes static above content, each group becomes a horizontal overflow-x scroll row of bordered pill links (white, 1px line), group titles hidden; 'Coming soon' text stays. No hamburger, drawer or bottom bar. The top bar does not adapt: at 390px the brand text wraps to three lines and the email and Sign out button overflow (document scrollWidth 421px at 390px viewport, measured). Tables with class 'stacked' turn into label/value rows under 720px. Grids use auto-fit minmax(320px) so Overview cards stack.
surfaces.active_state: NavLink sets aria-current='page' (nav.tsx:8-10); styled background var(--blue-soft) #e5eeff, text var(--blue-ink) #0047c2, weight 500, radius 8px (globals.css:152). Hover: #f3f7ff background. Overview uses exact match, others prefix match.
surfaces.fonts: Poppins 400/500/600 for words, JetBrains Mono 400/500/600 for keys, ids, chips, figures and code (Google Fonts, app/layout.tsx:23). Body 15px/1.6; H1 26px/600; H2 19px; H3 15.5px. Nav links 14px; group titles 11.5px uppercase 600 letter-spacing .06em.
surfaces.a11y: Focus ring 2px solid #0062fb, offset 2px (globals.css:41). Skip link. aria-current on active link; nav has aria-label 'Console'. Reduced motion: only button transitions disabled (globals.css:88). Nav links ~38px tall and btn-sm 32px (below the brand kit's 44px target). No icons, so nothing to label.

notes: AXLE Central requirements, from docs/07-operations-and-axle.md (full write-up with file:line refs in axle-central-requirements.md). WHAT IT IS: one operator view across every AntaraX product at axle.antarax.ai, its own host, never under api.antarax.ai (07:17; decision 0009:10); Stage 2, same app as the AntaraX Hub (08:100; roadmap 12:39). It does NOT replace product AXLEs: each product keeps its own AXLE (axle.angka/yara/yo/janka, frame-axle) for depth and AXLE Central deep-links into them (07:7-17). DATA: reads each product only through AXLE Link, four signed internal endpoints: tenants (id, label, owner email, plan, API on, stopped), usage totals by tenant/route/unit/day (max 92 days), health (ok/degraded/down + problems), and POST switches (07:31-52). A product may refuse central switches (403 switches_refused) and every call is audited on the product side (07:49-50). SECTIONS each product's AXLE API section has, which Central should summarise across products: Tenants (API on/off, plan, limit overrides, stop with reason, notes), Keys (every key: prefix, mode, scopes, made by, last used; stop one / all of a tenant), Switches (all / product / tenant / key, each with a reason callers see), Calls (calls, errors, p50/p95 by day, route, tenant; latest failed calls with request ids), Lookup (one call by request id) (07:19-29). Also access requests for Lapisan Console (approve with plan / decline with reason, email owners) and sandbox/partner tenants shown as such (13:57, 13:173). OPERATOR TASKS: incident playbook (flooding key: switch off key; bad release: switch off product; leaked key: stop it, search usage by key id; everything: switch off all) with typed customer-facing reasons (07:80-90); watch signals: calls/errors/latency, one failed call by request id, unknown errors, operator audit, tenants near cap (07:68-76); alerts to build: error rate >5% for 5 min, tenant >80% of daily cap, door p95 >300 ms, usage writes failing, email first (07:78). CROSS-PRODUCT NEEDS: one staff role ladder viewer < support < operator < admin < owner, two people for irreversible actions once >2 operators (07:54-66); link tenants of different products into one AntaraX account by owner email or company registration number (08:110); cross-product usage statements and one invoice later (12:42); one sign-in for REKA staff (brand kit 13 §6); data protection rules (no bodies, 13-month usage retention, Singapore region) (07:92-99). In this repo there is no AXLE UI: only the AXLE Link contract/handlers in packages/lapisan-core/src/link and a demo-only Approve/Decline stand-in on the console's Go live page.
